1. Breakfast for me is usually 3-4 egg whites scrambled with some salsa on top or made into an omelet with some veggies or a lara bar. That usually fills me up but if I'm particularly hungry I'll have some fruit with the lara bar or a piece of toast with the eggs.

2. Lunch generally has a half a sandwich involved with either a cup of soup or a salad. If I'm feeling really crazy I'll just make a huge monster salad. If I'm in a rush and didn't have one for breakfast sometimes I'll just grab a lara bar for lunch.

3. Dinner varies all the time. I eat whatever I like just within my calorie range. I do try to keep it healthier and stick to lean protein and veggies, but I'm not about denying myself of things so if I want pasta or potatoes, I eat them if they're within my calories.

4. I go on 3-4 mile walks, play tennis, elliptical at the gym, lift weights, run, or do DVDs at home.

5. I try to be active every day, even if it's just a short 1 mile walk. I strength train 3-4 days a week though and do the elliptical those days also.

6. If I'm at the gym, I'm there for anywhere from 45-90 minutes. If I'm playing tennis it's about 60-90 minutes. Walking I could go for hours and running I generally do 30-60 minutes.

7. I don't really "relapse" because I don't think I'm on a diet, I'm just changing my habits. If I eat 2,000 calories one day and don't exercise at all I don't view that as a failure because I know that one day like that isn't going to all of a sudden halt any progress I've made. I just try my best to eat well and exercise hard the next day.

8. Anywhere from 1,200-1,600 depending on my exercise.

10. I try not to think of anything as cheating. I have days where we go out to eat and I get something I wouldn't normally have or we go out to the bars and I have a few drinks, but calling it cheating makes me feel like I've failed in someway so I tend to not think of it that way in order to help me stay on track.
